verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee runs headless browsers behind a request/response API. Its JavaScript scenarios are pre-scripted instructions sent with a single API call, not a live remote browser session a developer can drive interactively or manually. Nothing in the evidence describes a managed interactive browser sandbox, live session or remote-control endpoint, so the axis applies but is unsupported.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows
